title: Moroccan Crispy Fennel Fries (Keto)
description: A delicious and crispy fennel fry recipe, seasoned with moroccan spices, perfect for a keto diet.
instructions: Cut the fennel into fry shape.
In a large bowl, combine the fennel fries, olive oil, salt, black pepper, Moroccan spice blend, garlic powder, and paprika. Toss to coat.
Heat a large skillet or deep fryer with about 2-3 inches of olive oil to 375°F.
Add the fennel fries to the hot oil in batches, being careful not to overcrowd the skillet.
Fry the fennel fries for about 3-4 minutes, or until crispy and golden brown.
Using a slotted spoon, remove the fennel fries from the oil and place them on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
Repeat the frying process with the remaining fennel fries.
Serve the crispy fennel fries hot and enjoy!
